shortDescription: Information module for System Issue Definitions Count

options.name: deviceType
options.description: DeviceType query parameter. These are the device families/types supported for system issue definitions. If no input is made on device type, all device types are considered.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id query parameter. The definition identifier. Examples id=015d9cba-4f53-4087-8317-7e49e5ffef46 (single entity id request) id=015d9cba-4f53-4087-8317-7e49e5ffef46&id=015d9cba-4f53-4087-8317-7e49e5ffef47 (multiple ids in the query param).

options.name: issueEnabled
options.description: IssueEnabled query parameter. The enablement status of the issue definition, either true or false.

options.name: name
options.description: Name query parameter. The list of system defined issue names. (Ex."BGP_Down") Examples name=BGP_Down (single entity uuid requested) name=BGP_Down&name=BGP_Flap (multiple issue names separated by & operator).

options.name: priority
options.description: Priority query parameter. Issue priority, possible values are P1, P2, P3, P4. `P1` A critical issue that needs immediate attention and can have a wide impact on network operations. `P2` A major issue that can potentially impact multiple devices or clients. `P3` A minor issue that has a localized or minimal impact. `P4` A warning issue that may not be an immediate problem but addressing it can optimize the network performance.

options.name: profileId
options.description: ProfileId query parameter. The profile identier to fetch the profile associated issue defintions. The default is `global`. Please refer Network design profiles documentation for more details.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
